title: CENTURY 21 Premier Realtors - 1101 S 17th Street
description:
Please enjoy this property video created by CENTURY 21 Premier Realtors

1101 S 17th Street
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$179,900, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,526 SF, MLS# 580960

Hidden Gem!!! Welcome home to this meticulously kept home on a large double size corner lot, with a pool, in a quiet mature subdivision. Enjoy the added elbow room and comfort of having extra canvas space to plant or make each area your own. 

The hospitable front porch initiates that warm feeling the house exudes and would be perfect for a couple of rocking chairs to enjoy a warm cup of coffee watching the sun rise or a sweet ice tea for sun set. Walking into the home you are greeted with hand crafted shelfing in a quaint sitting room or a second family room. Picture that perfect spot to place your Christmas tree. It is great to think about Christmas year-round! Am I right?!?! On the left side of the house flows the kitchen, with additional handmade shelves, cabinets and countertops, the dining area and a large living room with a beautiful bay window. The laundry has its own room and sits just off the living room. The opposite side of the house are where the 3 good sized bedrooms are located. 1 bathroom sits in the hallway servicing 2 of the bedrooms and any guests you might have while the other bathroom is tucked away off the main bedroom. Stepping into the backyard you will be overcome by the feeling of tranquility within the fully fenced backyard with a fabulous pool. There remains plenty of canvas should you want to lay pavers, start a garden, make a firepit or an elaborate outdoor grilling station with a gas or log fire pizza oven!

Whether you are looking for your first home, final home or a rental / Airbnb this home is for you! With only known minor cosmetic changes needed you can slip right into the very competitively priced home with ease. Come view this home today and make it yours tomorrow with a dip into the pool just as the Texas heat is arriving!!

2 full bath
